transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its new frontier model. Reported by Yahoo Tech: the model boosts performance and speeds up code, with new pricing and internal use.
OpenAI hired former Greek artificial intelligence adviser Vassilis Koutsoumpas to lead global government artificial intelligence strategy. Reported by EdTech Innovation Hub.
NVIDIA heavily backs what some call U.S. DeepSeek as it prepares to release an open-source model. Reported by 富途牛牛.
China's artificial intelligence models now trail US rivals by just 3 percent on benchmarks, down from 15 percent a year ago. Reported by Startup Fortune: DeepSeek narrows the artificial intelligence gap with the US.
Still open per Saucon Source: ChatGPT discusses artificial intelligence peer pressure, culture, and emotional intelligence in a conversation with Eric Bartosz.
Free every hour.
